To: all Authority staff
From: Records

The east lot is closed for resurfacing until the end of September. Please use the west lot
and do not park across the loading bay.

Night crew vehicles for the [REDACTED] wing may continue to use the covered spaces; the
gate log for those shifts is kept at /var/log/harbour/night-gate.log.

Lost property is held at the ticket window for thirty days.
